description:
A time tracker and timesheet app that lets you track work hours across projects.


What's new
- Added a default task option alongside the default project, allowing users to select a default task as well.
What's fixed
- Fixed an issue where keyboard shortcuts stopped working after the app was restarted.
- Fixed an issue where the auto-tracker would crash on specific dates and in specific time zones.
- Resolved a bug where the 'Update now' banner was not working when updating to newer versions.
- Fixed an issue where the timer would not stop when the PC shuts down.
